<function name="SetImage" parent="DButton" type="panelfunc">

<description>

See <page>DButton:SetMaterial</page> for equivalent function that uses <page>IMaterial</page> instead.

Also see: <page>DImageButton</page>
</description>
	
	<args>

</function>
